Round_Island.decision: No point or score. The physical Mira River island is distinct from the community farther east. Reviewed source context and native detail did not establish a clearly isolated matching island; nearby peninsula and engraving geometry must not be substituted. This is not a claim of historical absence.

South_Head.decision: Adopted CB22 on main geographic panel, not the separate Cow Bay inset. The source explicitly labels Cape Morien or South Head. Original reference class WACOIS10 is retained; geographic setting and continuous headland geometry establish the correspondence.

Enon.decision: Adopted the eastern lake/stream junction. The old northern approach is drawn as a brook while modern geometry has a longer lake arm; no whole-basin centroid was substituted.
